description:
One chat conversation: its newest messages in order (role, content, run_id,
    created_at), a page of `limit`, with earlier_cursor for the older ones (null when the
    page reaches the first message), and the runs those messages hold, with their hooks,
    plus nullable language and country search picker settings. Same shape as GET
    /v1/conversations/{conversation_id}. Free. Errors: 404 conversation_not_found, 422 for
    an id that is not a UUID or a cursor this API did not issue.

before.description: earlier_cursor from the previous page; leave out for the newest messages
before.title: Before

limit.description: messages per page, newest page first
limit.title: Limit

name: get_conversation
